name: scoutmagic-js-tests
description: Development-only Node/npm tooling for ScoutMagic's first-party browser JavaScript: static analysis (TypeScript's checkJs, no emit), unit tests (Vitest + jsdom), and end-to-end browser tests (Playwright + Chromium). Not required to run, build, or deploy ScoutMagic itself — production JavaScript stays plain, unbundled, and Node-free. See AGENTS.md and ARCHITECTURE.md.
